title: Comments
intro: Every comment under build updates, newest first. A comment is taken down through its case with a statement of reasons, not here.
caption: Comments with author, build, open reports, date and status

flag.on: Comments are switched on for members.
flag.off: Comments are switched off for members (flag build_comments). Only comments from tests and previews are listed.

empty_body_on: As soon as members comment under build updates, the comments are listed here.
empty_body_off: Comments are switched off. Once the flag is on and members comment, they are listed here.
